native_mechanisms: Grey wax trough where each mark's impression is pressed atop all prior still-warm impressions, so the medium holds only the churned sum, never a clean single picture
Seven bell-jars of differently-hungry insect swarms each bite a dipped wire in their own count and rhythm, fixed forever by a forward-only spinning slate wheel that can never be walked back
A brine basin freezes the wire's bite-pattern, after waiting for frost-lace to stop spreading, into a unique six-flower lattice sketched to tin as the only surviving token
core_technique: xxHash-style striped hashing: seven parallel accumulator lanes with distinct odd multipliers and per-lane rotate-multiply over 56-byte blocks, folded into one accumulator, 8/4/1-byte tail, then Murmur3 fmix64 avalanche finalizer.
